title: China sanctions Skydio, cutting off its battery supplier Dongguan Poweramp

goods: drone batteries; lithium-ion batteries; drone components
claude_reason: Dated Chinese sanctions on Skydio forced its Chinese battery supplier Dongguan Poweramp to stop supplying it, which bears directly on the Skydio X10 case.
